title: Learn Shapes for Kids! Circle, Square, Triangle and More
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bloop, and welcome to Bloop's Color Lab!
Today we're meeting five shape friends.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Ready? Let's wiggle into the lab!

lines: Here's a clue: it's round, like a ball! Can you guess?
This is Circle! A circle is round and round.
A circle has no corners at all.
Can you draw a big circle in the air?
Can you guess? What else is shaped like a circle?
Wheels are circles, so they can roll.
Here's a clue: it has four sides, all the same! Can you guess?
This is Square! Let's count the corners.
One, two, three, four! A square has four sides that are all the same.
Can you draw a square in the air?
Can you guess? What else can be a square?
Here's a clue: it looks like a slice of pizza! Can you guess?
This is Triangle! Let's count the corners.
One, two, three! A triangle has three sides and three corners.
Can you make a triangle with your fingers?
Can you guess? What snack can look like a triangle?
Rooftops can look like triangles, too.
Here's a clue: it twinkles in the night sky! Can you guess?
This is Star! Let's count the points.
One, two, three, four, five! This star has five points.
Can you twinkle your fingers like stars?
Can you guess? Where can you see stars?
In the night sky! Twinkle, twinkle!
Here's a clue: it means love! Can you guess?
This is Heart! A heart means love.
You can make a heart with your hands!
Can you give yourself a big hug?
Can you guess? What does a heart mean?
You can draw a heart for someone you love.

outro: Which shape was your favorite? Keep looking for colors and shapes everywhere you go.
Bye, friends! See you in the lab!
